subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should explicit typed `/new` and hard `/reset` require a default confirmation, and should OpenClaw add any opt-out/config surface for that behavior?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the change alters documented command semantics across clients and may add public config; repository policy requires maintainer intent before changing that behavior.

options.title: Confirm hard resets by default
options.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` exempt, and defer config until evidence proves an opt-out is needed.

options.title: Add configurable confirmation
options.body: Add the confirmation plus a documented opt-out or step-count setting, accepting the added config, docs, and upgrade-policy burden.

options.title: Preserve explicit command behavior
options.body: Keep typed reset commands immediate and limit confirmation to visible UI buttons or future non-command affordances.

recommendation.title: Confirm hard resets by default
recommendation.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` exempt, and defer config until evidence proves an opt-out is needed.
